description: This file provides Greek localization (translations) for the Select2 jQuery plugin (version 4.0.6-rc.1). It defines error messages, prompts, and labels used by the plugin when interacting with users in Greek.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message when the user input exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message prompting the user to input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while a search is in progress.
